create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal with a specified number of atoms using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal lattice with a specified number of unit cells using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells
create_water_box: create a periodic box of randomly placed water molecules using get_water_box
create_slab_adsorbate: create an FCC slab with an adsorbed molecule and OC20-style atom tags using get_slab_adsorbate
create_slab_with_fixed_subsurface: create a slab system with fixed subsurface atoms and tagged adsorbate using get_slab_adsorbate
